item.title: Ask HN: Has HN considered adding dark mode?
item.summary: It’s 2026, and HN is one of the few sites that I use that still has no dark mode, which is annoying when using it on my phone. A three-way toggle for system/light/dark appears to be best practice now. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49268396 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
